task.title: Drag and drop vertically within a column doesn't scroll
task.description:
For a column with a lot of tasks, a user may want to drag a task to reorder it beyond the current viewport of the column. However trying to drag a task above or below the viewport doesn't scroll the column, so it isn't possible to reorder a task more than a few spaces at a time.

Fix: dragging a task above or below the fold of a column smoothly scrolls the column in that direction.
